players.bio: Aaron Joseph McGowan (born 24 July 1997) is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre back/right-back for EFL League Two club Port Vale.
Abdul-Yussuf Adedeji Adeniyi "Deji" Oshilaja (born 2 March 1993) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for Mansfield Town.

Baily James Cargill (born 5 July 1995) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League One club Mansfield Town. Cargill is a left footed centre back who can also play at full back.

Benjamin Matthew Garrity (born 12 February 1997) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League Two club Port Vale. He is also the club captain. Garrity began his career playing non-League football at Merseyside-based clubs NSC Junior, Oyster Martyrs, Formby and Lower Breck, winning Lower Breck's Player of the Season award in 2016–17.

Cameron Lisceous Humphreys-Grant (born 22 August 1998) is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL League Two club Port Vale F.C. Club career Humphreys is a graduate of the youth system at Manchester City. In the summer of 2015, a 16 year old Humphreys travelled with the first team squad on their preseason tour and played in a friendly fixture against Real Madrid.

Connor Hall (born 23 May 1993) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League Two club Port Vale. He is also a vice-captain. Hall began his career with Isthmian League side Bury Town, playing for the club from 2011 to 2016, apart from a short spell spent with St Neots Town in 2015.

David James McGoldrick (born 29 November 1987) is a professional footballer who plays as a striker for EFL League One club Mansfield Town. He won 14 caps for the Republic of Ireland national team between 2014 and 2020, scoring one international goal. A trainee at Notts County, he made his senior debut in 2004 before being signed by Southampton later in the year.

Elliott Jack Hewitt (born 30 May 1994) is a Welsh professional footballer who plays as a defender or midfielder for EFL League One club Mansfield Town. He can play in a variety of different positions, including right-back, centre-back, winger or central midfield. He is known for his versatility and pace.
Frazer John Blake-Tracy (born 10 September 1995) is an English professional footballer who plays as a left back for EFL League One club Mansfield Town.

George Benedict Abbott is an English professional footballer who plays for Mansfield Town , on loan from Premier League club Tottenham Hotspur. A youth product of Tottenham Hotspur since the age of 7, Abbott worked his way up through their youth categories. He signed his first professional contract with the club on 15 March 2023.

George Cardinal Joseph Hall is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League Two club Port Vale. Hall has represented England at under-18 level. Hall received his first call-up to the England under-18 squad in November 2021.

George Thomas Maris (born 6 March 1996) is an English professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for EFL League One club Mansfield Town. Maris began his career at Barnsley at under-15 level, signing his first professional contract on 29 May 2014 after a 20-goal season for the under-18s.
Harry Charles John Lewis (born 20 December 1997) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for club Mansfield Town.
Jaheim Anthony Headley (born 24 September 2001) is an English professional footballer who plays as a left-back for EFL League Two club Port Vale.
Jasper Moon is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League Two club Port Vale.

Jonathan Edward Russell (born 9 October 2000) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Mansfield Town. Born in England, he represents the Jamaica national team. Born in Hounslow, Russell joined Chelsea at under-7 level. He turned professional in October 2017. He moved on loan to Accrington Stanley in October 2020. He moved to Huddersfield Town in July 2021.

Jordan Nathaniel Bowery (born 2 July 1991) is an English professional footballer who plays for Mansfield Town. After beginning his careCrewe Alexandra, as a striker.er with Derby County, Bowery had an extended spell at Chesterfield, coming through their youth team to make over 100 appearances in all competitions for them. While with Chesterfield he also had a short loan spell with Barrow.

Jordan Jay Lawrence-Gabriel (born 25 September 1998) is an English professional footballer who plays for Port Vale. Club career Nottingham Forest Gabriel-Lawrence joined the Nottingham Forest academy from Southend United in February 2015. He signed professional terms with the club in January 2016.
Kyle Michael Dempsey (born 17 September 1995) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Port Vale..
Kyle Alex John (born 13 February 2001) is an English professional footballer who plays as a right-back for EFL League Two club Port Vale.

Kyle Andy P. Knoyle (born 24 September 1996) is an English footballer who plays as a right-back for EFL League One club Mansfield Town. He made his debut for West Ham in 2015, and has since been loaned to both Dundee United and Wigan Athletic during 2016. He has represented the England under-18 team.
Lewis Lee Montsma (born 25 April 1998) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League Two club Port Vale.
Liam Joseph Roberts (born 21 November 1994) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper who currently plays for Mansfield Town.

Liam Francis Thompson is an English professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for EFL League One club Mansfield Town. Career Thompson joined the Derby County youth set-up as a teenager, having played youth football with Nottingham-based Dunkirk. During the 2018–19 Under 18 season, Thompson played an influential role in Derby's title-winning campaign.

Louis Samuel Reed (born 25 July 1997) is an English footballer who plays as a midfielder for Mansfield. Having come through the ranks of Sheffield United's Academy, Reed made his first-team debut in a 1–0 home victory against South Yorkshire rivals Rotherham United on 8 April 2014. At 16 years and 257 days old, he is the youngest player ever to represent Sheffield United in league football.

Lucas Jordan Jeremiah Akins is a professional footballer who plays for EFL League One club Mansfield Town. Akins started his career at Huddersfield Town, progressing through the club's youth academy before making his first-team debut in April 2007. During the 2007–08 season, he was loaned out to Conference National side Northwich Victoria for three months.

Luke Philip Bolton (born 7 October 1999) is an English professional footballer who plays as a winger and full-back for EFL League One club Mansfield Town. Bolton began his career with Manchester City, and spent time on loan at Wycombe Wanderers, where he made his professional debut, Luton Town, and Scottish club Dundee United. He moved to Salford City in January 2022.
Maleace Kobby Afriyie Asamoah (born 15 November 2002) is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League Two side Wigan Athletic.
Marko Maroši (born 23 October 1993) is a Slovak professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL League Two club Port Vale.

Max James Watters is an English professional footballer who plays as a striker for EFL League Two club Port Vale. Watters started his career playing non-league football with Thurrock, Barking and Ashford United before signing with League One side Doncaster Rovers in summer 2018.
Michael John Smith is an English professional footballer who plays as a striker for EFL League One club Mansfield Town.
Nathan Daniel Moriah-Welsh (born 18 March 2002) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League One club Mansfield Town.

Nigel Howard Clough (born 19 March 1966) is an English professional football manager and former player who is currently the manager of Mansfield Town. Playing predominantly as a forward, but later in his career used as a midfielder, Clough was capped by England 14 times in the early 1990s.

Oliver David James Lynch (born 2 November 2004) is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-forward for EFL League Two club Port Vale, on loan from EFL League One club Luton Town. Lynch began his career at Luton Town, from where he was loaned out to Hitchin Town, Dulwich Hamlet, Hemel Hempstead Town, Tamworth, and Port Vale.
Ollie Taylor (born 30 September 2006) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Mansfield Town F.C. in EFL League One.

Onel Lázaro Hernández Mayea (born 1 February 1993) is a Cuban professional footballer who plays as a left winger for EFL League Two club Port Vale and the Cuba national team. He emigrated to Germany as a child, and played in the 2. Bundesliga for Arminia Bielefeld and Eintracht Braunschweig.
Owen Joel Dodgson is an English footballer who plays as a left-back or left wing-back for EFL League One club Mansfield Town, on loan from EFL League One club Stockport County.
Regan Hendry (born 21 January 1998) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder .
Rhys Derek Oates (born 4 December 1994) is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League One club Mansfield Town.

Ryan Sweeney (born 15 April 1997) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL League One club Mansfield Town. Born in England, he has represented the Republic of Ireland internationally.
Stephen Antony McLaughlin (born 14 June 1990) is an Irish footballer who plays for EFL League One club Mansfield Town as a defender.
Taylor Ellis Anderson is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League One club Mansfield U21

Tyler D'Whyte Roberts is a professional footballer who plays as a forward or attacking midfielder for EFL League One club Mansfield Town and the Wales national team. He is an academy graduate of West Bromwich Albion and made his professional debut for the club in May 2016. Loan spells in League One with Oxford United, Shrewsbury Town and Walsall followed before he joined Leeds in January 2018.
